Fractured rock can lose mud faster than sand.
Most crews think fluid loss is a sand problem. Open joints in rock can swallow more mud in a shift than soft ground ever will.

Filter Low works in both. On heavy losses, pair it with Filter High to thicken the cake.

Light dose on a clean water bore. Heavier program on fractured ground or long HDD shots.
Where do you reach for Filter Low first, sand or rock?
